blocking_finding.why_no_reviewer_can_fix_it: task_review_merge_gate.py derives merge authority from the canonical row of the task id on the head branch, and it fails closed on a missing row by design. scripts/ai-status.sh approve binds an approval to a task row; there is no row for L12-POST-4380-GAP-DISPATCH-20260729 to approve or reopen. Approving this review task (SUP-L12-POST-4380-GAP-REVIEW-20260729) does not feed the gate for a different task id, so an approval here would be a no-op that falsely reads as progress. Reopening is equally unavailable for the same reason: reopen also targets a row.

Retire PR #4382 outright as superseded, since Waves 0/A/C are largely archived and the packet's actionable surface has shrunk to Wave D.
